---
title: "Sanctuary Boston Song Ideas"
toc: false
---

Songs Andy might try leading at Sanctuary Boston. Each idea takes a chorus or a
few key lines from a longer song. These are notes, not full tabs.

## People Get Ready

The Frames. The chorus and a bit of the verse.

| We have all the time in the world to get things right
| To get things right
| We have all the love in the world to set alight
| To set alight

## Hold Out Your Hand

Brandi Carlile. The chorus, with one extra line from Andy (in brackets).

| Hold out your hand
| Take hold of mine and then
| Round and round we go
| [The devil can't get your soul]
| Don't you wanna dance?
| I'm a dying man
| From the moment we began
| Hold out your hand

Then sing over it, three or four times:

| Ba-da-da, ba-da-da, ba-da-da
